name: Talking to Boop always gets a face, kind or hurt
case: The person holds Boop's button and says something while an agent works. Boop can't talk back, but it always answers with a face: proud at praise, hurt or put out at an insult, and a pleased or curious face for a question about the tests, maybe puzzled or pleased. It never stays quiet when spoken to.
why: PERSONALITY: when the person talks to Boop it always answers with a face, never none; kind words make it proud, rude ones wounded, and its Examples give each. What you said always wakes the brain
